## Deep Dive (read when needed)

See `llm-docs/DOM-SHARED.md` — async polling primitives (`poll` / `pollify` / `chunkify`), browser URL/frame helpers (`absolutizeUrl`, `isInlineFrame`, `isAccessibleFrame`), and the sandbox plugin + runtime iframe-isolation wrapper (under `plugins/`, not `src/`).

## Build

Built via the JS workspace (nx). See `js/CLAUDE.md` for workspace build commands.

> This package intentionally ships a single combined `DOM-SHARED.md` rather than the `OVERVIEW`/`MAPPING`/`BUILDING` triad: it is a tiny, three-concern library whose role, file map, tests, and gotchas all fit one focused doc (see the `## File Map`, `## Tests`, and `## Gotchas` sections there).
